lines.t: (Rhythmic shaker, quiet ticking clock, pulsing warm sub-bass)
(Whispered atmospheric vocals echoing)
Ten lanterns waiting in the shadow of the gate
Counting every breath while the night grows late
Five held the golden vessel filled to the brim
Five left their future to the fading of the dim.
The silence grows heavy, the eyelids grow slow
How long till the hidden shadow starts to glow?
[Pre-Chorus]
(Organic drums building, rimshots accelerating)
Slowly the embers begin to turn to gray
Who kept the fire for the promise of the day?
You can't buy the moment when the dark takes hold
You can't borrow fire when the air turns cold!
[Build-up]
(Deep synth risers, rhythmic clock ticking intensifies)
(A echoing horn/shofar sample sounds in the distance)
Listen...
A shout in the streets...
(A echoing horn/shofar sample sounds in the distance)
Listen...
A shout in the streets...
(Spoken in a deep, gravelly, cinematic male baritone voice)
[Hebrew Shouted] *Hinne ha’chatan ba... tze’u likrato!*
(Look, the bridegroom comes... go out to meet him.)
[Drop]
(Deep Afro-House drop, heavy pulsing kick, shimmering rhythmic synth plucks)
Keep the oil in the lamp! Keep the flame burning high!
Midnight is breaking through the velvet sky!
We won't be caught sleeping when the night turns clear
The light is awake, and the dawn is here!
[Verse 2]
(Bassline continues, sparse Female vocal delivery)
Knocking on a wooden door that’s sealed in stone
Standing in the quiet of the dark alone
(Bassline continues, sparse Female vocal delivery)
Knocking on a wooden door that’s sealed in stone
Standing in the quiet of the dark alone
(Deep male baritone - distant echoing spoken voice)
[Hebrew Spoken] *Lo yadati etchem...*
("I never knew you...")
(Female vocal continues, soft and haunting)
echoes through the floor
Oil isn't something you can trade at the door.
It’s bought in the secret, built in the quiet space
A spark kept alive in the secret place.
[Pre-Chorus]
(Drums building, ethereal pads swelling)
Slowly the embers begin to turn to gray
Who kept the fire for the promise of the day?
You can't buy the moment when the dark takes hold
You can't borrow fire when the air turns cold!
[Build-up]
(Snare filter opening up, fast polyrhythmic percussion)
(Deep cinematic spoken male voice)
[Hebrew Spoken] *Shifchu shemen... ha'sha'a hagi'ah.*
(Pour the oil... the hour has come.)
[Drop]
(Full energy Afro-house drop with lush melodic lead synths)
Keep the oil in the lamp! Keep the flame burning high!
Midnight is breaking through the velvet sky!
We won't be caught sleeping when the night turns clear
The light is awake, and the dawn is here!
[Bridge]
(Music strips back completely to kick drum and atmospheric pads)
Vigilant heart. Unbroken light.
Ready for the call in the middle of the night.
Vigilant heart. Unbroken light.
[Outro]
(Synthesizers gently filtering out, solo warm percussion)
The door is open...
The lamps are burning.
Holy light...
(Soft fade out)
